Third-party notices

Source: THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md

hfutils is licensed under Apache-2.0 (© Lynker Spatial). That license applies to Lynker Spatial’s own code in this repository.

This package depends on third-party R packages that carry their own licenses. Those packages are not redistributed with this source; they are installed separately from CRAN (or their upstream source) by the end user, so their licenses govern the user’s use of those packages, independent of the Apache-2.0 grant here. Several are copyleft (GPL/LGPL); using hfutils requires installing them and complying with their terms.

This notice is provided for transparency and to answer reuse questions; it adds no constraint to the Apache-2.0 grant on Lynker Spatial’s code.
